text:
My neighbor recently decided to take security seriously, erecting a bold sign that read, "Beware of Dog." The irony arrived promptly with the postman, who was greeted by my three-pound furball—a creature whose primary defense mechanism is likely to trip over its own paws. The postman, perhaps sensing the lack of threat, sarcastically exclaimed, "Oh no, I'm so scared!" That comment clearly struck a nerve. Now, my tiny dog is on a relentless mission to prove him wrong, though I suspect his idea of "beware" involves aggressively licking the postman’s shoes until he apologizes for the insult.

The color of an eggplant is purple.
